login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your account details to start a sales shift

shiftSetup.title: Start your shift
shiftSetup.noWarehouse: No warehouse is authorized for your account. Ask an administrator to assign you to a branch.
shiftSetup.noRegister: No active register in this branch. A manager must add one before a shift can be opened.
shiftSetup.openingFloatHint: The cash physically in the drawer right now.
shiftSetup.blindCloseWarning: At the end of the shift you will count the drawer and enter the amount. The expected figure is not shown to you.

pos.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, barcode, or SKU
pos.scanHint: Scan a barcode or type to search
pos.emptyCart: Cart is empty — search for an item to add it
pos.estimateNotice: Estimate — the real total is computed by the server at checkout

checkout.title: Complete sale
checkout.creditSaleHint: Credit sale to a registered customer — payments may be left empty
checkout.changeNotice: Change is handed back from the drawer. The sale records the amount due only.
checkout.overTendered: That is more than the amount due. Adjust the tender to match exactly.
checkout.stockWarning: Some lines may not have enough stock. The sale will confirm or refuse at checkout.
checkout.serialsMustBeUnique: Each serial number can only be entered once.

returns.title: Returns
returns.noSales: No sales in this shift yet
returns.saleNumberHint: Type or scan the number printed on the receipt, e.g. INV-A1B2C3D4
returns.notFound: No sale found with that number in this business.
returns.orPickRecent: or pick one from this shift
returns.refundExactNotice: This is a walk-in sale, so the whole credit must be handed back now.
returns.refundLedgerNotice: Refund what the customer takes now; the rest stays on their account.
returns.serialsMustBeUnique: Each unit can only be chosen once.
returns.refundOverMax: That is more than the credit due. It cannot exceed {{max}}.
returns.chooseAction: What is happening with this sale?
returns.actionReturnDescription: Goods come back and the customer is refunded or credited.
returns.actionExchangeDescription: Goods come back and different goods go out, settled in one step.

shiftClose.title: Close shift
shiftClose.blindNotice: Blind close: enter what you actually counted in the drawer — the expected amount is not shown to you.
shiftClose.countInstruction: Count the cash in the drawer now.
shiftClose.expectedWithheld: The expected figure and the variance are reviewed by a manager. They are not shown at the till.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this action
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.

exchange.title: Exchange
exchange.evenNotice: An even swap — nothing to pay and nothing to refund.

holds.title: Held sales
holds.notASaleNotice: A held basket is not a sale. Nothing has been paid, no stock has moved and no receipt exists until it is resumed and completed at the till.
holds.holdExplainer: The basket is put aside so the till is free. Nothing is sold and no money is taken. Prices, tax and promotions are worked out when you pick it up again.
holds.labelHint: So you can find it again - "blue coat lady", "table 4"
holds.indicativeNotice: An indication only. The real total is worked out by the server when the basket is resumed.
holds.cancelConfirm: Basket {{holdNumber}} will be marked cancelled and can no longer be resumed.
holds.cancelNotice: No money moves and no stock changes. The basket stays visible under Cancelled.
holds.noLongerOpen: This basket is no longer held - someone else has already resumed or cancelled it.
holds.otherWarehouse: This basket was held at another warehouse and cannot be resumed from this till.
holds.resumingNotice: Not sold yet. Finish at the till to complete the sale.
holds.checkoutNotice: Prices, tax, promotions and loyalty have just been worked out afresh - not when the basket was held.

cashDrawer.title: Cash drawer
cashDrawer.noShiftExplainer: You have no open shift. Open one against a register to start selling.
cashDrawer.blindHint: This till closes blind. You will be asked to count the cash and enter the amount; the expected figure is not shown to you.
cashDrawer.awaitingReconciliation: A manager still has to review and accept this shift.
cashDrawer.reconciled: A manager has reviewed and accepted this shift.
cashDrawer.movementsNotice: Each movement of physical cash through this drawer, as it happened. No running total is shown.
cashDrawer.movementExplainer: For cash that moves by hand — a float top-up, money to the safe, petty cash. Sale takings and refunds record themselves.
cashDrawer.movementAmountHint: Always a positive amount. The direction comes from the type above.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.explainer: Look up a sale to register or check the warranty on a serial-numbered item it sold.
warranty.noSerialItems: Nothing on this sale carries a serial number
warranty.noSerialItemsHint: A warranty covers one specific physical unit, so only serial-numbered items can have one.
warranty.voidedNotice: This warranty was voided - usually because the unit was returned. It covers nothing and cannot be claimed against or registered again on this sale line.
warranty.claimExplainer: Record what the customer reports. The claim is logged for the workshop to review and resolve; it is not decided here.
